name: Stickfingers' mobile
description: A mobile of twigs and bark hung from Arinos's porch that binds Old Stickfingers as guardian of the house.

timeline.summary: At Arinos's farm Vadrik finds a twig mobile and deduces that Arinos summoned Stickfingers to get rid of Salvasi.
timeline.quote: "Arinos summoned Stickfingers to dispose of Salvasi and save his farm," Vadrik said.

timeline.summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
timeline.quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

timeline.summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
timeline.quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.

relations.note: Vadrik concludes that Arinos built the sigil and summoned Stickfingers with it.
relations.quote: Built the sigil and hung it from the farmhouse.
